name: Relume
tagline: AI website builder that generates sitemaps, wireframes, and style guides.
description: Relume helps designers and agencies build marketing websites faster by turning a short brief into AI-generated sitemaps, wireframes, and style guides. Its outputs export to Figma, Webflow, and React, and pair with a library of 1,000+ pre-built responsive components. A free-forever tier covers basics, with paid plans unlocking the full component library and unlimited projects.
insight: Began as the world's largest Webflow component library before adding an AI Site Builder that turns a prompt into sitemaps and wireframes.
edge: Outputs aren't throwaway mockups — generated sitemaps and wireframes export as editable design files, not just static previews.
pros: Generates full sitemaps and wireframes fast
Exports to Figma, Webflow, and React
cons: Advanced features gated to paid tiers
